openQuestions: All years in Plymouth cards and proposals are US model years, not calendar production years (the source pages give model years).

models-auto 'business' (Q2099830) and 'new-finer' (Q1982566) could not be identified: Wikidata API rate-limited this session. 'Business' is probably a 1930s/40s trim (Business Coupe) rather than a model.

models-auto has 42 Plymouth entries but only 25 model lines/cards: savoy, plaza, cranbrook, cambridge, concord, deluxe, volare, sapporo, cricket, vip, model-30u, model-pa, roadking and others have no line or card. Should they get lines?

Most Plymouth cards still have no photos, dimensions or kW figures; EPA family cards (Colt, Horizon, Reliant, Sundance, Gran Fury …) span several real generations and were not split, only Voyager (AB/S/AS/NS) and Neon (1st/2nd gen) were split.
Model Q bounds rely on auction/press sources (RM Sotheby's, conceptcarz, macsmotorcitygarage); no en Wikipedia article exists.
summary: Plymouth cards were EPA/MY1970 snapshots with no years: filled family/generation bounds from en Wikipedia for all 25 lines, set every generation to ended (brand closed 2001), split Voyager into AB/S/AS/NS and Neon into two generations, and replaced 22 placeholder summaries with factual Czech text. Proposed line bounds for all 25 model-lines-auto entries, 5 models-auto removals (2 duplicates, 1 generation, 2 concepts) and 9 missing models.
